newsitem.title: CANADA: Tuesday frost likely in Alberta, Saskatchewan risk.
newsitem.headline: Tuesday frost likely in Alberta, Saskatchewan risk.

text.p: Alberta was likely to see a frost Tuesday morning while Saskatchewan's southern grainbelt faces a slight risk, Environment Canada said.
Frost was also likely across central and southern Alberta and into southern Saskatchewan Wednesday and Thursday mornings, Environment Canada said in its 10-day frost outlook.
A slight risk of frost was forecast for Alberta's northern grainbelt and Saskatchewan's central grainbelt Sept 25 and 26.
Slight risks of frost were forecast for the Peace River Valley and southeast Saskatchewan, south Manitoba Friday and Saturday mornings.

A slight risk of frost was forecast for the entire Prairie southern grainbelt Sept 29 to Oct 2, with a moderate risk across the central grainbelt and a likely frost seen on the northern grainbelt, Environment Canada said.

The Alberta Wheat Pool reported that Alberta's crops overall were 46 percent combined as of Friday, with hard red spring wheat 41 percent combined and Canada Prairie Spring wheat 25 percent. Oats were 28 percent combined and flax was 13 percent combined. Also canola was 48 percent combined.
